desc: Block until one or more containers stop, then print their exit codes
u: docker-container-wait - Block until one or more containers stop, then print their exit codes
Block until a container stops, then print its exit code.

$ docker run -d fedora sleep 99
079b83f558a2bc52ecad6b2a5de13622d584e6bb1aea058c11b36511e85e7622
$ docker container wait 079b83f558a2bc
0
